# Incident Title

<!-- Copy this template into notebook/incidents/<category>/<kebab-case-slug>.md
     and fill in each section. Do not fabricate evidence. -->

## Context

What systems were involved, what environment, and what was supposed to happen.

## Symptoms

Observable behavior and error messages.

## Evidence

Log excerpts, metrics, traces, and configuration. Facts only.

## Hypotheses

Possible causes considered.

## Timeline

Chronological record of investigation and actions.

## Experiments

What was tried and what each test showed.

## Dead Ends

Hypotheses ruled out and why.

## Technical Findings

What the evidence revealed.

## Root Cause

The verified cause.

## Resolution

What fixed it.

## Verification

How the fix was confirmed.

## Prevention

Changes to avoid recurrence.

## Lessons Learned

What would be done differently. Focus on process, not blame.

## Technologies

List of relevant technologies.

## References

Links, tickets, and docs.
